title: Dense Core Properties in the Infrared Dark Cloud G14.225-0.506 Revealed by ALMA
question: What are the properties (masses, virial state, mass function) of dense cores in the IRDC G14.225-0.506 hub-filament systems, and what do they imply for high-mass star formation?

data.sensitivity: rms 0.2 mJy/beam before primary beam correction

what.value: Kinetic temperatures from NH3, NH3 linewidths, 870 um APEX maps, filament virial parameters

evidence.quote: For the dust temperature, we use the kinetic temperature, $T_{\rm kin}$, derived from NH$_3$ ($J,K$) $=$ ($1,1$) and $(2,2)$ emission lines (cite: bus13).
The ID numbers of YSOs and X-ray sources are adopted from (cite: pov16).
The linewidths are measured from N$_2$H$^+$ (J=1-0) ALMA observations (Chen et al. in prep).

recipe.method: CASA CLEAN, natural weighting, 0.4 arcsec pixels
Clumpfind with 2 sigma threshold and 2 sigma steps; keep peaks above 5 sigma
Core is protostellar if a YSO or X-ray source lies within 4 arcsec of core centre
assumptions: YSO age 0.1 Myr, velocity dispersion width 0.8 km/s

recipe.method: M = F d^2 / (kappa B_nu(Td)) x f_d
assumptions: gas-to-dust 100, kappa=0.9(lambda/1.3mm)^beta cm2/g, beta=1.5; default T 22 K protostellar, 17 K prestellar

recipe.goal: Virial analysis of cores, clumps, filaments
recipe.method: Mvir=210 r dv^2 (uniform density); alpha=Mvir/Mcore; clumps from APEX 870um via Clumpfind with NH3 linewidths
assumptions: uniform density sphere; magnetic fields neglected

recipe.goal: Fit cumulative CMF of prestellar candidates
recipe.method: N(>M)=kM^-alpha+c fit with Poisson errors N^1/2, mass range 2.4-14 Msun

evidence.quote: We identify a total of 48 cores (29 in the northern part and 19 in the southern part).
we identify 20 protostellar cores and 28 prestellar cores candidates
As a result, the core mass ranges from 1.1 to 78 $M_\odot$.
The virial parameters of the dense cores are between 0.1 and 1.3
derived to be $1.6\pm0.7$ using the mass range from 2.4 to 14 $M_\odot$
we derive the maximum stellar mass to be **40 and 47 $M_\odot$, respectively**

not_stated_but_needed: Clumpfind implementation and exact parameters/mask handling
Line-free channels and continuum bandwidth used for the 3 mm map
N2H+ hyperfine fitting details (in Chen et al. in prep)
Procedure for the size deconvolution and FWHM radius
Fitting method for the CMF slope (binning, range choice)
Which clumps' tmperature values were adopted per core
missing_for_reproduction: Chen et al. N2H+ linewidth data
Table of per-core temperatures from Busquet 2013 already in Table 1
score_reason: Public data and a clear recipe for continuum cores and masses, but N2H+ linewidths and several imaging parameters are not given.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, core table in the paper gives numeric answer keys, continuum recipe largely stated.
